name: ptt-radio
title: PTT Radio
author: vshuraeff
description: Push-to-talk voice radio for multiplayer, with channels, a speaker HUD and admin controls. Every player who talks or listens needs the free ptt-radio companion app running and the game launched with --enable-lua-udp 34556. Required on the server and on every client. Setup guide: github.com/vshuraeff/ptt-radio/wiki
